title: Tiki Tiki
blurb: Nonsense with a rhythm apparently engineered to lodge in your auditory cortex and refuse eviction. TikTok specialises in this exact genre, sounds that spread for no reason beyond being enjoyable to repeat, and here is a textbook case. It means nothing. It does nothing. It cannot be got rid of by ordinary means. The repetition does something to the stress pattern that your brain files away as a hook, and once filed it stays filed. Resistance is available in theory and ineffective in practice. Play it at anybody claiming immunity to earworms.
origin: A viral nonsense chant from TikTok.
